item.title: Physician Views In-Depth: Non-invasive tools offer new diagnostic model for MASH
item.description: A new FirstWord survey indicates that blood-based tests and ultrasounds are overtaking liver biopsy as the most widely used diagnostic tools for MASH.

item.title: Physician Views Preview: Will Hepcludex unlock a hidden HDV population?
item.description: With the first US approval for a hepatitis D virus (HDV) treatment, Gilead Sciences has a new opportunity on its hands. FirstWord is polling doctors to gauge whether screening and diagnosis will improve enough to bring Hepcludex (bulevertide-gmod) to eligible patients.

item.title: Vital Signs: Who's getting the most bang out of their R&D buck?
item.description: R&D budgets are increasing ahead of pharma's looming patent cliff; FirstWord checks in on the companies that are getting the most and least revenue out of their R&D efforts.

item.title: Physician Views In-Depth: Wegovy favoured in moderate MASH cases
item.description: But according to a recent FirstWord survey, Rezdiffra will remain a backbone treatment for MASH, particularly among patients with more advanced disease.
